original.target_description: Experiment 2, 40 University of Bristol undergraduates; auditory six-digit lists, timing-recall task; paired-samples t test of grouped versus ungrouped grouping deviations at the fourth output position (observed latency minus second-order polynomial prediction).

n.sample_role: Participants contributing paired timing-task grouping deviations; the reported t(39) corroborates all 40 enrolled participants in this paired test.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for this test; no separate trial-exclusion rule stated for grouping deviations. Polynomial baseline excludes the first and fourth output positions; this is not participant exclusion.
n.location: Published p. 137 (PDF p. 10), Experiment 2, Method, Participants and Design; p. 138 (PDF p. 11), grouping-deviation paired test.
n.quote: Participants were 40 undergraduate students from the University of Bristol, who were recruited as part of an opportunity sample and who provided informed consent for participation.
